* \*ONS Chemo/Bio course completed within two years of hire if employed on units where chemo is administered


 Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:
   

  

* Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)

* Requires full range of body motion including handling and lifting patient, manual and finger dexterity, and eye\-hand coordination.

* Exposure to communicable diseases and/or body fluids.

 Aura Reception
 



**Location:**

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary Range:** 
 $145,000 – $180,000 base salary, depending on experience
 


 Company Description
 
 Aura Reception builds AI voice receptionist and automation systems for clinics, service businesses, and growing companies. Our platform helps businesses handle inbound calls, appointment scheduling, lead intake, customer questions, reminders, follow\-ups, and backend workflows through AI voice agents, SMS, calendar integrations, CRM systems, and automation pipelines.
 



 We are focused on building practical AI systems that solve real operational problems for customers. Our work sits at the intersection of voice AI, workflow automation, applied LLMs, customer operations, and business process automation. We move quickly, work directly with customers, and build systems that need to be reliable in real\-world environments.
 


 Role Description
 
 We are looking for an AI Engineer / Forward Deployed AI Engineer to help design, build, deploy, and improve AI\-powered receptionist and automation workflows for real customers.
 



 This role is a mix of software engineering, AI workflow development, customer\-facing implementation, and systems problem\-solving. You will work across backend services, LLM workflows, voice AI agents, integrations, databases, and automation tools to turn customer needs into working production systems.
 



 You should be comfortable moving between technical implementation and customer context. Some days you may be building APIs, improving agent logic, or debugging workflow issues. Other days you may be working with a customer to understand their scheduling process, map out their call handling needs, or deploy a custom automation workflow.
 



 This is a strong fit for someone who likes building fast, using AI tools effectively, working close to customers, and owning projects from idea to deployment.
 


 Responsibilities
 * Build and deploy AI voice receptionist workflows for customer use cases such as scheduling, lead qualification, FAQs, reminders, routing, and follow\-ups.
* Design backend systems, APIs, and workflow automations that connect voice agents, calendars, CRMs, forms, SMS, databases, and third\-party tools.
* Work directly with customers to understand their operations and translate requirements into reliable technical workflows.
* Develop LLM\-powered workflows using prompt engineering, tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and guardrails.
* Build internal tools, dashboards, and automation systems to support implementation, monitoring, and client operations.
* Debug production issues across voice AI, API integrations, webhooks, databases, and automation flows.
* Improve reliability, latency, error handling, observability, and testing for deployed AI systems.
* Collaborate with sales, operations, and implementation teams to support demos, pilots, and customer launches.
* Use AI coding and productivity tools to move faster while still maintaining high\-quality engineering standards.
* Own projects end\-to\-end from scoping and design to deployment, monitoring, and iteration.


 Requirements
 * Strong experience with software engineering, backend development, or full\-stack development.
* Experience building with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, or similar modern development tools.
* Experience working with APIs, webhooks, databases, authentication, and third\-party integrations.
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, structured outputs, or workflow automation.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to speed up development, research, debugging, and documentation.
* Ability to work directly with customers, understand business workflows, and translate messy requirements into clean technical systems.
* Strong debugging skills and comfort working across different layers of a system.
* Ability to work in a fast\-moving startup environment with shifting priorities and high ownership.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical users.
* Comfortable taking ownership of projects without needing every step defined upfront.

 ?

* Apply vision language models to evaluate semantic understanding and controllability across our world simulation products.

* Mentor engineers on the team and provide technical guidance on architecture and execution.

* Track record of training large\-scale generative models (diffusion models, flow matching, vision language models, etc.)

* Experience developing autonomous systems, robotics software, or autonomous vehicle simulations.

**Company Overview**
 Allen Control Systems (ACS) is a cutting\-edge defense startup, founded by two former Navy electrical engineers with a proven track record in robotics and software. We are developing a small, autonomous gun turret that employs advanced computer vision and control systems to precisely target and neutralize small drones and loitering munitions. Our innovative approach requires overcoming significant technical challenges, making this an exciting and dynamic environment for experienced engineers.
   

  

 With an engineering\-first culture, ACS values technical excellence and innovation. Backed by our founders' successful exits from two previous venture acquired for a combined $180M in 2022, we are committed to ensuring that the groundbreaking technologies we develop will have a real\-world impact.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a Software Platform/Infrastructure Engineer to own the software that builds, provisions, updates, and manages our fleet of autonomous systems in the field. You will be responsible for the delivery of "robot factory software" — the imaging, deployment, and fleet\-management layer that everything else ships on.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build and maintain Jetson imaging and provisioning pipelines for repeatable, reliable device bringup.
* Develop the fleet agent and over\-the\-air (OTA) update system for safely updating software across deployed units.
* Own system services, startup/bringup sequencing, and host\-level configuration (systemd, networking, security hardening).
* Work with Embedded Systems to define manufacturing ATP test and diagnostic hooks for the production line.


**What You'll Need:**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in Python and shell; comfort reading/modifying C\+\+ as needed (replaces the "strong C\+\+ proficiency" line).
* Deep Linux fundamentals: services, networking, filesystems, boot process, package management.
* Hands\-on experience with embedded Linux and/or single\-board compute (NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, etc.).


**You'll Stand Out**
* NVIDIA JetPack / L4T, Yocto, or embedded Linux build systems.
* A/B OTA / robust update frameworks (Mender, RAUC, balena, or homegrown).
* Infrastructure\-as\-code and fleet\-management tooling.
* Manufacturing test, ATP, or hardware bring\-up / factory automation experience.
* Observability stacks (Foxglove, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary
* ACS Equity Package
* Health, Dental, Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off
